line.name: Montecristo Espada
line.description: Not on the site. Three distinct sub-lines under the Espada name, each a genuinely different blend, not just vitola variants of one product.

vitolas.name: Espada (original) - Ricasso
vitolas.notes: Habano Jalapa 2010 wrapper, 2009 Jalapa binder, tri-vintage habano filler. Released 2014.

vitolas.name: Espada Oscuro - Ricasso
vitolas.notes: All-Nicaraguan Plasencia tobacco, habano rosado oscuro wrapper.

vitolas.name: Espada Oscuro - Quillon
vitolas.notes: Note: size differs from the original Espada's Quillon (6x56).

vitolas.name: Espada Signature - Valiente
vitolas.notes: Jalapa Colorado Claro wrapper, Nicaraguan binder/filler. Limited release. Only this one vitola confirmed - full Signature lineup unverified.

research_notes: Additional Espada sub-lines 'Estoque' and 'Conquistador' were referenced in passing during research but not independently verified - not added.
